summary: Boston, Massachusetts, former Psych major at Cornell University, programmer with a focus on functional programming, strong interest in Elixir and Erlang, avid gamer with a history of playing Zork and NetHack, critical of echo chambers and political correctness, advocates for rational debate and critical thinking, has a Tesla vehicle, engaged in home renovation projects, expresses skepticism towards traditional marriage, identifies as a rationalist, interested in cryptocurrency, particularly Bitcoin, and has a strong disdain for programming languages that promote mutability and complexity.
